mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) solutions may reduce ganciclovir absorption and increase renal clearance through osmotic effects and altered GI transit time, while both agents can contribute to dehydration and electrolyte imbalances affecting renal function.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor renal function closely and ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative bowel preparation methods if ganciclovir therapy is critical.
